_doc: Business policy, not fitted parameters. Changing it changes the model's decisions, so it is reviewed like code.
xgb_params_source: Hyperparameters of the previously deployed model (app/models/best_params.pkl), tuned in the notebook on an 80/20 split; kept fixed so the constrained/unconstrained comparison isolates the effect of the constraints.
cost_ratio_doc: A missed default (false negative) costs this many times a false alarm (false positive).
grades_doc: A PD belongs to the first grade whose max_pd it is strictly below (E catches the rest). Boundaries set before looking at results: base rate is about 3%.

Net worth/Assets.doc: Debt ratio % + Net worth/Assets = 1 exactly for every firm in the data.

counterfactual.adjustable_doc: Ratios management can move (pay down or refinance debt, raise cash, retain earnings). Every one is monotone-constrained, so the risk-reducing direction is known. Bounds: 1st-99th percentile of the training data.

revenue_change_pct.label: Revenue change (%)
revenue_change_pct.doc: Revenue / assets and revenue / share scale with revenue. Profit ratios are not touched here: see profitability_shift_pctile.

interest_rate_change_pct.label: Interest cost change (%)
interest_rate_change_pct.doc: The firm's cost of interest-bearing debt rises by this percentage.

debt_change_pct.label: Debt change (%)
debt_change_pct.doc: More borrowing with assets unchanged. Net worth/Assets is reset to 1 - Debt ratio %.

profitability_shift_pctile.label: Profitability drop (percentile points)
columns: ROA(A) before interest and % after tax
ROA(B) before interest and depreciation after tax
ROA(C) before interest and depreciation before interest
profitability_shift_pctile.doc: Profit ratios in this dataset are offset-normalised (about 0.5 = break-even), so a % change has no meaning; instead each is moved down this many percentile points of the training distribution, floored at the 1st percentile (P0 is a single extreme outlier).
